'''Peter Nordstrom Endor Objective''' is a [[Dark]] deck by [[Peter Nordstrom]], published on [[Torch Industries]].<ref name="torch">[http://members.aol.com/drtorch/CC.html Endor Objective by Peter Nordstrom], Torch Industries (Paul Todd Feldman). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000302180852/http://members.aol.com:80/drtorch/CC.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Peter Nordstrom]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]] (from the card pool)
* '''Published:''' [[Torch Industries]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost|Endor-D-endoroperations.gif|label=Endor Operations}}
* '''Strategy:''' Endor Operations
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Nordstrom DS Endor Ops Torch.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==
Feldman watched Nordstrom show this deck at a playtesting session and called it cheap, fast and confusing. It sets up on the ground or in space; Feldman wrote that [[Imperial Arrest Order]] makes it nearly unbeatable for ground decks.<ref name="torch" />
